emptyBody: Create your first project to begin.

wizard.title: New project
wizard.stepTwo: Step 2 of 3: how the project starts
wizard.failed: The project was not created. Try again.
wizard.name: Project name
wizard.slugInvalid: Use 2 to 32 lowercase letters, numbers or hyphens.
wizard.slugTaken: That name is taken. Choose another.
wizard.prefixHint: Like GTV in GTV-123. 2 to 6 capital letters.
wizard.prefixTaken: That prefix is taken. Choose another.
wizard.docsPathHint: A full path on this machine. It is read, and nothing is written there.
wizard.stepThree: Step 3 of 3: its folder on a device (optional)
wizard.folderHint: A full path on the chosen device. A Claude chat in this folder lands on this project.
wizard.folderInvalid: Use a full path, such as F:/Projects/my-app.
wizard.noDevice: No device is connected now, so create the project and link its folder later in Settings › General.
wizard.linkNote: Linking writes this folder's trust into Claude Code on that device, once and with a backup, so no trust dialog appears. It happens only on this press, and only for this folder.
wizard.linkPreview: Pressing Create and link registers {folder} on {project} and links it on that device.
wizard.linkShape: Created {project}. Claude Code's settings on that device were not as expected, so nothing was written there: accept the trust dialog once when you open {folder}.
wizard.linkMcp: Created {project}. Claude Code on that device could not add the project's server for {folder}: Settings › Devices shows why.
wizard.linkFailed: Created {project}, but {folder} was not linked: {reason} Link it in Settings › General.
